comparison.objective: Insert an SO-101 servo into its shoulder-bracket pocket in the correct orientation.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a loose bracket, align a close-fit servo, press it fully home, and set the assembly down.
comparison.success_condition: Servo within 1.5 mm/5 degrees during entry and within 1 mm/2 degrees when seated, horn correctly oriented, bracket upright and released.
comparison.reason: This close-fit robot assembly shares alignment and bimanual stabilization, but its tested outcome is intact component insertion. It lacks impact delivery, manufactured-notch fracture, retained-coil protection, and free-fragment recovery; no separate spec is present, though the body supplies a detailed rubric.
